```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| label: fig-Bernoulli_Distribution
#| fig-cap: Bernoulli distribution.
# Packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Plot
p_values <- c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8)

bernoulli_df <- do.call(
  dplyr::bind_rows,
  lapply(p_values, function(p) {
    data.frame(
      x = factor(c(0, 1), levels = c(0, 1)),
      prob = c(1 - p, p),
      p = paste0("p=", p)
    )
  })
)

ggplot2::ggplot(bernoulli_df, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = prob, fill = p)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(
    position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(fill = "Parameters") +
  ggplot2::ylab("Probability") +
  ggplot2::xlab("x") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
